notes.title: Exhibitor Information at Tokyo Game Show 2025!
notes.notes:
[p]Frontier Works Inc. will be showcasing two 2025 releases—[i]The Aquarium does not dance Special Edition[/i] and [i]Heroic Songs: the Remix![/i]—at Tokyo Game Show 2025, hosted at Makuhari Messe from September 25 - 28, 2025![/p][p]Both games will be exhibited at the Frontier Works Inc. booth, where attendees can experience firsthand the charm and creativity that define each title.[/p][p]To commemorate the event, [i]The Aquarium does not dance Special Edition[/i] is now on sale! Don’t miss your chance to grab it at a discount, just in time for the spooky season![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45673567/9ce65e44d0db570e28b6655421f916d588300476.png"][/img][/p][p]
[b] ◆ Event Dates[/b]
September 25 (Thu) – September 28 (Sun), 2025

[b]Business Days:[/b] September 25 (Thu), 26 (Fri); 10:00 - 17:00 JST
[b]Public Days: [/b]September 27 (Sat); 9:30 - 17:00 JST, September 28 (Sun); 9:30 - 16:30 JST

[b] ◆ Venue:[/b]
Makuhari Messe Halls 1 - 11 + International Conference Hall + Event Hall

[b] ◆ Booth Info[/b]
[b]Exhibitor:[/b] Frontier Works Inc.
Indie Game Corner

notes.notes:
